name: What maintenance is involved with an outdoor pizza oven?

mainEntity.name: What maintenance is involved with an outdoor pizza oven?

acceptedAnswer.text: Maintaining an outdoor pizza oven typically involves regular cleaning to remove ash and food debris, especially for wood-fired models. For all types, inspecting for cracks or structural issues, particularly in areas exposed to weather, is important. Protecting the oven with a cover when not in use can significantly extend its lifespan, especially in climates with varying weather patterns like the San Francisco Bay Area, preventing moisture damage and material degradation.
acceptedAnswer.description: Maintenance includes regular cleaning, inspecting for structural issues, and using a protective cover, especially in varying climates, to extend oven lifespan.
